item.prompt: How did the museum visit go?

completedSentence: The volunteers who led us through the new wing were wonderful.
distractorNote: Seven tiles for six blanks. "was" is the unused distractor: it forces number agreement against the plural "volunteers". "the" and "new wing" are two separate tiles, which is why six blanks take six tiles.
sourceNote: This project's own item, written in the shape of the one Build a Sentence item ETS publishes (Updated TOEFL iBT Test Overview, 2026, p. 13): seven tiles for six blanks, the opening article and the closing adjective fixed in the frame, a relative clause, and a singular-verb distractor against a plural subject. It is also the early-ramp worked example in .claude/skills/toefl-writing/references/generation-guide.md.
